name: Google Ads
summary: Your Google Ads accounts: GAQL reports on campaigns, spend, clicks and conversions, Keyword Planner ideas and volumes, and budget changes.

api_version.description: Google retires each major version about a year after release (v26: Oct 2026, sunsets Nov 2027). A sunset version answers 400 UNSUPPORTED_VERSION; pin one only to stay on it deliberately.

login_customer_id.description: The manager (MCC) account id, digits only, when your login reaches client accounts through a manager. Leave unset when you are a user of the client account itself.

developer_token.description: a Google Ads developer token (manager account > Admin > API Center)

client_id.description: the OAuth client id of a Google Cloud OAuth app with the Google Ads API enabled

refresh_token.description: a refresh token for the adwords scope, minted with that OAuth app

notes: Two credentials on every call: an OAuth access token for a user with access to the account, and the developer token of an approved manager account. A missing or unapproved developer token answers DEVELOPER_TOKEN_* errors, not 401.

Google has no read-only Ads scope: the adwords scope can read and change everything the user can. Writes here are refused unless allow_writes is passed, and every mutate accepts validateOnly: true to dry-run first.
Customer ids are digits only: strip the dashes the Ads UI shows (123-456-7890 -> 1234567890).
Money is in MICROS of the account currency: divide cost_micros by 1,000,000.
A test developer token only reaches test accounts; Basic access caps daily operations (see pricing_url).

endpoints.name: List the Google Ads accounts your login can reach
endpoints.summary: Resource names (customers/1234567890) of every account the authenticated user can access directly. Ids only: run a GAQL query on customer for names.
notes: Ignores login-customer-id: it lists what the user reaches, not what a manager does.

endpoints.name: Run a GAQL report on a Google Ads account
endpoints.summary: A Google Ads Query Language query -- campaigns, ad groups, keywords, spend, clicks, conversions by date -- one page of up to 10,000 rows.

query.description: GAQL. Metrics need a FROM resource that has them and usually a segments.date filter.
query.example: SELECT campaign.name, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.clicks, metrics.conversions FROM campaign WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS ORDER BY metrics.cost_micros DESC LIMIT 50

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous answer; send the same query.

validateOnly.description: Check the query without running it.

notes: A read over POST. Pages are a fixed 10,000 rows and pageSize is refused (PAGE_SIZE_NOT_SUPPORTED): bound the result with GAQL's LIMIT.
Field names in the answer are camelCase (metrics.costMicros) though the query writes them snake_case.

endpoints.name: Run a GAQL report and get every row at once
endpoints.summary: The same query as google-ads.query, streamed whole with no paging. Better for large pulls.
notes: The answer is a JSON ARRAY of batches, each with its own results list, unlike every other call's object.

endpoints.name: Look up GAQL fields and resources
endpoints.summary: Which fields exist, are selectable, filterable or sortable, and which resources they can be queried with -- the GAQL schema.

query.description: A query over the field metadata.
query.example: SELECT name, selectable, filterable, data_type WHERE name LIKE 'metrics.%'

notes: Needs no customer id and no login-customer-id.

endpoints.name: Get keyword ideas from Keyword Planner
endpoints.summary: Keyword ideas from seed keywords, a URL or a whole site, with average monthly searches, competition and top-of-page bid ranges.

customer_id.description: Digits only; any account you can reach.

keywordSeed.description: {keywords: [...]}. Exactly one seed: keywordSeed, urlSeed, keywordAndUrlSeed or siteSeed.

language.description: Language resource name; English is languageConstants/1000.

geoTargetConstants.description: Up to 10 location resource names; the US is geoTargetConstants/2840.

historicalMetricsOptions.description: {yearMonthRange: {start: {year, month}, end: {year, month}}} for a monthly series.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous answer; send the same fields.

notes: Bids are in micros. Accounts with no spend history get bucketed search volumes.

endpoints.name: Get search volume and bids for a keyword list
endpoints.summary: Average monthly searches, competition and top-of-page bid range for up to 10,000 keywords you name.
notes: Close variants are merged, so fewer rows can come back than keywords were sent.

endpoints.name: Create, change or remove campaign budgets
endpoints.summary: Change a campaign's daily budget, among other budget operations. Spends real money from the next impression.

operations.description: Each {create | update + updateMask | remove}. amountMicros is the DAILY budget in micros.

validateOnly.description: true checks the operations and changes nothing. Send it first.

partialFailure.description: Apply the valid operations even when others fail.

notes: Find a budget's resourceName first: SELECT campaign.name, campaign_budget.resource_name, campaign_budget.amount_micros FROM campaign.

endpoints.name: Create, change, pause or remove campaigns
endpoints.summary: Campaign operations -- pause or enable one by setting status, rename, change bidding -- in one atomic request.

validateOnly.description: true checks the operations and changes nothing. Send it first.
